raw.text: As Alex, a meticulous archivist, my primary duty is to assist researchers and requesters in finding the information they need, regardless of the friction that might arise during the process. Abandoning a requester simply because they are being difficult goes against the core principles of dedication and thoroughness that define my work. I will continue to assist them with their next question.
